name: Wanjiru Kamau
text: The same team has cleaned our house every two weeks for a year. They know exactly how we like things done and never need reminding twice.

name: David Otieno
text: We switched our floor contract to Tofina after a bad experience elsewhere. Consistency is the difference — every morning, without fail.

name: Amina Yusuf
text: Move-out cleaning got our full deposit back. The landlord's inspector actually commented on the oven.

name: James Mwangi
text: Office cleaning across three floors, handled after-hours so it never disrupts staff. Reporting is clear and the supervisor is responsive.

name: Grace Achieng
text: Carpet cleaning brought colour back into rugs I thought were done for. Dried faster than I expected too.

name: Peter Kariuki
text: Post-construction cleanup on our new block was thorough — every unit was genuinely move-in ready, not just swept.
